subject: Intermittent slowed API responses — BrightBridge (US-EAST)
content:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@brightbridge.ai>
Cc: Elise Wong <elise@brightbridge.ai>
Date: Sun, 4 Apr 2027 09:03:00 -0400
Subject: Intermittent slowed API responses — BrightBridge (US-EAST)

Hi Samir / Elise,

We wanted to let you know we’re investigating reports of intermittent slowed responses from our hosted API in the US‑EAST region that may be affecting some BrightBridge requests. Our telemetry shows an elevated p95 token latency beginning around 08:40 EDT and a small increase in retry/errors for a subset of request paths.

Quick summary:
- What we saw: increased p95 generation time and occasional 5xxs for a small percentage of traffic in us‑east.
- Impact: some BrightBridge requests may take ~2–4x longer to return than normal; a minority of requests returned 5xx.
- Scope: appears targeted to a specific serving pool in us‑east; not account‑wide.
- Current status: mitigation in progress (traffic routing adjustments and cache warmups); investigating root cause.

We’ve opened internal incident INC‑427 and published a brief on the status page (link below). I’ll continue to send updates as we confirm mitigation and a timeline to return to normal. We will also compile a post‑incident summary and include token-level impact for BrightBridge for any billing/credit discussions.

Status page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-427
Attachment: incident-log-us-east-20270404.txt (text/plain)

Apologies for the disruption — we know low latency is critical for your production flows.

Best,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Customer Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference

------------------------------------------------------------
From: Samir Patel <samir@brightbridge.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elise Wong <elise@brightbridge.ai>
Date: Sun, 4 Apr 2027 09:22:13 -0400
Subject: Re: Intermittent slowed API responses — BrightBridge (US-EAST)

Thanks Hannah.

Two quick questions:
1) Can you confirm whether our production traffic is being routed to a fallback model or a different pool?
2) Do you have an ETA for full recovery? Our inference calls are timing out for some user sessions and that’s impacting UX.

If helpful I can share request ids (we’ve captured several) — Samir

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 4 Apr 2027 09:30:47 -0400
Subject: Fwd: Intermittent slowed API responses — BrightBridge (US-EAST)

Ben, Laura — forwarding customer thread. Per telemetry this looks like a serving‑pool scheduling imbalance that caused eviction storms and slower KV cache hits in us‑east. Ops has rolled a traffic shift to a healthy pool and is warming caches; p95 has started to come down but we’re still watching.

Action items:
- Ben: please keep BrightBridge looped and share any customer request IDs they provide. Confirm any SLA credit steps later if impact confirmed.
- Laura: loop in Legal/Finance if this escalates to a credit request (I’ll provide the token impact).
- Ops: we need a post‑incident timeline and root cause notes once available.

I’ll post an update to the status page after we confirm stable metrics.

Hannah

Thanks Hannah — I’ll coordinate with BrightBridge and collect request ids.

Samir — I’m looking at your logs now; if you can paste three of the request ids you captured I’ll surface them to the ops team and track them through the incident log. We’re flagging this with priority for potential SLA review.

Also: can we confirm whether any of the affected requests called the reranking endpoint last 24 hours? That helps narrow the paths.

— Ben
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

------------------------------------------------------------
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@brightbridge.ai>, Elise Wong <elise@brightbridge.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 4 Apr 2027 15:28:00 -0400
Subject: Update: Intermittent slowed API responses — BrightBridge (US-EAST)

Hi Samir / Elise — final update for today:

What we completed:
- Shifted ~18% of BrightBridge traffic off the affected serving pool to a healthy pool at 10:12 EDT.
- Warmed KV caches and reduced cold misses; p95 improved from ~1200ms to ~260ms for impacted routes by 10:40 EDT.
- Ops captured detailed request traces for the 08:40–10:12 window and attached the trimmed incident log for your review.

Files attached: incident-log-us-east-20270404.txt (trimmed traces), statuspage-incident-INC-427.png (status page snapshot).

Next steps / postmortem plan:
- Ops will produce a short postmortem (root cause: scheduling imbalance leading to eviction cascade in one serving pool) by Tue 2027‑04‑06 17:00 EDT.
- We will include a per-account token and request impact table for BrightBridge to support any billing/credit conversation.
- Ben will continue to be your primary contact for credit/contract questions.

Preliminary note on credits: if postmortem confirms measurable user impact consistent with our SLA, we will propose a proportionate credit and include that calculation in the postmortem. We’ll confirm numbers by Tue.

Appreciate your patience — reach out if you spot anything else in your logs.

Best regards,
Hannah Schmitt
Customer Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference
